agent_note: Two distinct narrating stances coexist in the quote set, and they do not look like one narrator's two time positions. Strand A: first-person retrospective past, age-anchored ('even at thirteen I had my doubts'), oriented on a character called Mr. Harrigan (q04520, q04526, q04530, q04534, q04538, q04540). Strand B: third-person simultaneous present about an unnamed 'she' (q04537, q04541), with no overlap of persons or referents with Strand A. This reads as a multi-strand or multi-story volume rather than a diary/epistolary dual. Heavy gnomic contamination: 11 of 25 quotes are aphorism or essayistic generalization, exactly the quotability bias METHODOLOGY warns about; a two-bucket filter would have read most of them as present-tense evidence. Quotation marks survive on only one quote (q04522), so dialogue was assigned from vocatives ('kiddo', 'Craig'), imperatives, and second-person direct address. Event yield 9 of 25: 6 past / 3 present. All 3 present-event quotes are load-bearing and are flagged individually.
